blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language models can be adapted by changing the computations applied to individual tokens. Quantum circuits offer one such approach, but evaluating wider circuits inside a large model can be computationally demanding. Here we introduce HyperQ, which adds token-conditioned quantum residual branches to a frozen masked-diffusion language model. A quantum residual branch is a module in each transformer block that reads a token’s hidden state, emits the coordinates of that token’s circuit, executes it and adds the measured values back through a residual connection. The backbone remains frozen, and only the added branches are trained. Within each branch, a lightweight circuit hypernetwork emits token-specific rotation angles, coupling strengths and measurement axes in a shared sparse circuit structure. The required expectation values have an exact classical expression whose evaluation cost grows linearly with the qubit count, enabling circuits from 16 to 64 qubits to be trained within a 1.1-billion-parameter backbone. Across downstream benchmarks, increasing circuit width raises the average score from 47.65 to 54.30. At 64 qubits, HyperQ exceeds the backbone and its low-rank-adapted counterpart by 4.71 and 3.67 points, respectively. HyperQ is fine-tuned on 20,000 prompt-response pairs, compared with 200,000 for the classical baselines. These findings support token-conditioned circuit emission as a tractable architectural approach to quantum-augmented language modelling.
blocks.zh: 语言模型可以通过改变应用于单个符号的计算方式来调整. 量子电路提供一种这样的方法,但评价一个大模型内较宽的电路可以进行计算要求. 在这里,我们引入了HyperQ,它为冷冻的遮掩扩散语言模型添加了象征性的有条件的量子残留分支. 量子剩余分支是每个变压器块中的一个模块,它读取一个符号的隐藏状态,释放该符号的电路的坐标,执行它,并通过一个剩余连接添加测量值. 骨干仍然被冻结,只有新增的分支才得到训练. 在每个分支内部,一个轻量级的电路超网络释放出符号特定旋转角度,在共享的稀疏电路结构中组合强项和测量轴. 要求的预期值有一个精确的古典表达式,其评价成本随着方位计的线性增长,使得16到64个方位的电路能够在11亿参数的骨干范围内得到训练. 纵观下游基准,线路宽度的增加将平均得分从47.65提高到54.30。 在64qubits上,HyperQ分别以4.71和3.67的点数超过主干及其低排名的适应对应. HyperQ在20,000对快速响应对上进行了微调,而古典基线则有20万对. 这些发现支持以象征性条件的电路排放作为量子增强语言建模的一种可牵引的建筑方法.

blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] are built predominantly on the attention-based transformer
architecture [ 4 ] .
Their progress has relied primarily on larger models and training corpora,
supported by increasing amounts of classical
compute [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] . This progress spans two main generative paradigms.
Autoregressive models [ 8 ] factorise text from left to
right and commit one token per forward pass. Diffusion-based
models [ 9 ] instead refine an initially corrupted representation
over multiple steps. Masked-diffusion models [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] apply this process to text by iteratively
denoising masked positions in parallel under bidirectional context, which
enables non-autoregressive generation. The diffusion family is now following a
development trajectory similar to that of autoregressive models. It includes
billion-parameter open models [ 13 , 14 ] , models
pre-trained on 12T tokens [ 15 ] , and 100B-scale mixtures of
experts [ 16 , 17 ] , which route each input through a
subset of model components. Diffusion models can also be particularly
competitive when data, rather than compute, is the limiting
resource [ 18 ] . These developments leave open a
complementary architectural question. Can a different kind of computation
inside the network improve language modelling, and do token-conditioned quantum
circuit layers become more useful as their width increases?

Parameterised quantum circuits, which are quantum gate sequences with trainable
rotation angles, offer one candidate for this additional
computation [ 19 , 20 ] . Existing integrations with
transformers, however, have primarily studied parameter-efficient adaptation,
where a small set of trainable parameters modifies a largely fixed model. They
have not tested whether language-model quality improves as the quantum resource
increases. One line of work inserts variational circuits directly into
transformer computations. Variational circuits inside a 150M-parameter
transformer [ 21 ] only match classical quality, while a quantum
self-attention layer [ 22 ] is matched by a classical bottleneck of
the same size. Another line constrains model updates through unitary structure.
Cayley unitary adapters [ 23 ] improve a frozen 8B model by about 1.4 % 1.4\% in perplexity while disclaiming quantum advantage. Unitary
updates [ 24 ] pursue parameter efficiency under a related
adaptation setting. A further line combines quantum components with classical
low-rank or tensor adapters. Examples include hybrid quantum-tensor
adapters [ 25 ] and quantum low-rank
adapters [ 26 , 27 ] . Each approach evaluates its quantum
component at a fixed resource level, such as a fixed circuit width. These
results therefore do not establish whether increasing the number of qubits
makes a language model better.

blocks.en:
Testing the effect of circuit width presents two fundamental obstacles. Circuit
width is the number n n of qubits in the circuit. The first obstacle is
trainability. Unstructured variational circuits can exhibit barren
plateaus [ 28 ] , where gradient variance vanishes
exponentially as n n increases. The second obstacle is computational
practicality. Exact classical simulation of a generic n n -qubit pure state
requires a statevector containing 2 n 2^{n} amplitudes. Repeatedly evaluating such a
circuit for individual tokens inside a billion-parameter model therefore becomes
prohibitively expensive as the circuit widens. Circuit structure links these
two obstacles. In particular, strong trainability guarantees can coincide with
circuit families that remain efficiently classically
simulable [ 29 ] . A useful width study must therefore
identify a circuit family whose readout remains tractable at the tested widths
and whose gradient statistics can be characterised explicitly.

Simply widening a fixed, hand-designed circuit does not provide the
token-specific adaptation required inside a language model. The circuit must
respond to each token’s contextual representation. At the same time, its
structure must preserve usable gradients as the width increases, and its
readout must remain computationally practical. Automated quantum-circuit design
addresses the rigidity of hand-designed circuits through several distinct
mechanisms. One line treats circuit structure as an architecture-search
problem. Quantum architecture search [ 30 ] adapts neural
architecture search [ 31 ] to select gates and connectivity.
Differentiable variants [ 32 , 33 ] instead optimise
continuous relaxations of these discrete choices. Another line formulates
circuit synthesis as optimisation over continuous gate
parameters [ 34 ] , or derives explicit criteria for the
expressivity and trainability of candidate
circuits [ 35 , 36 , 37 ] .

blocks.en:
A third line treats the circuit as a compositional object that can be sampled. A
generative flow network [ 38 ] begins from an empty circuit, adds
one gate at a time, and stops when its policy selects a terminal action. The
transformer policy outputs a categorical distribution over the next gate, so
the resulting circuit is represented as a sequence of discrete gate symbols
rather than as a set of continuous coordinates. Its diversity follows from the
trajectory-balance training objective rather than from a separate exploration
bonus. At a solution to trajectory balance, the probability of each terminal
architecture is proportional to its reward. This condition spreads probability
mass across architectures with comparable quality instead of collapsing onto a
single architecture. The main computational cost lies in evaluating that
reward, because scoring one sampled architecture requires optimising its
continuous parameters from scratch. Architecture-search and sampling methods
therefore choose among discrete circuit structures while performing a separate
continuous optimisation. Continuous synthesis avoids this discrete outer
selection, but it still produces a circuit for a fixed task or target. Despite
their different mechanisms, these approaches generally operate at relatively
small qubit counts and independently of the language model. A token-level
quantum branch requires a different capability. It must emit and train a circuit
as part of each token’s language-model computation while remaining trainable
and computationally practical at wider tested circuits.

blocks.en:
HyperQ provides this capability by replacing task-level circuit selection with
continuous, token-conditioned circuit emission. Rather than searching for one
circuit and reusing it across all inputs, HyperQ conditions the emitted circuit
coordinates directly on the language model’s hidden states. It attaches this
token-specific quantum branch to a frozen masked-diffusion backbone. Within each
transformer block, a fused query-key-value projection uses one linear map to
produce the query, key and value tensors for attention. HyperQ places the
quantum branch in parallel with this frozen projection. A
hypernetwork [ 39 ] , which is a network that emits the
parameters of another computational module, maps each token’s hidden state to
the coordinates of its circuit. HyperQ realises this hypernetwork as a low-rank
adapter [ 40 ] . After executing the emitted circuit, HyperQ projects
its quantum readout and adds the result to the query, key and value tensors
through a residual connection. The masked-diffusion backbone remains frozen
throughout training. Only the added quantum branches and their low-rank
projections are optimised end to end under the masked-diffusion objective.

Within a 1.1-billion-parameter frozen backbone, we evaluate HyperQ with 16, 32
and 64 qubits. The average score across six downstream benchmarks improves from
47.65 to 52.80 and 54.30 across these three tested widths
(Fig. 5 ). At 64 qubits, HyperQ reaches 54.30, compared with 49.59
for the frozen backbone and 50.63 for the same backbone with a classical
low-rank adapter. These results correspond to differences of 4.71 and 3.67
points, respectively (Table 1 ). At 16 qubits HyperQ scores 47.65 and
remains below the frozen backbone, so the gain appears only as the register
widens. HyperQ is fine-tuned on 20,000
prompt-response pairs, compared with 200,000 for the classical baselines.
Continuous emission outperforms the tested fixed ansätze and
token-conditioned discrete motif searches at each width
(Table 3 ). A bounded paired evaluation on a benchmark subset
then replaces analytic readouts with measurements from a 156-qubit
superconducting quantum processor while keeping the model weights unchanged
(Fig. 6 ). We claim no quantum advantage. The readout remains
classically efficient at every tested width, so the results support
token-conditioned circuit emission as a tractable architectural approach to
diffusion language modelling without relying on classically hard readouts.

blocks.en: Masked discrete diffusion decodes text by repeatedly predicting masked positions rather than generating tokens only from left to right. At the start of decoding, x 1 x_{1} denotes the fully masked sequence. At an intermediate round t t , x t x_{t} denotes the partially denoised sequence, and x 0 x_{0} denotes the clean sequence after T T denoising rounds. The denoiser with parameters θ \theta predicts the token distribution p θ ( ⋅ ∣ x t ) p_{\theta}(\cdot\mid x_{t}) according to the LLaDA-style masked-diffusion recipe [ 13 ] . Each round commits the most confident predictions and masks the remaining positions for further refinement.
blocks.zh: 蒙面的离散扩散通过反复预测蒙面位置来解码文本,而不是只从左到右生成符号. 在解码开始时,x1 x_{1}表示全遮蔽的序列. 在中间圆 t, x t x_{t} 表示部分去诺的序列, x 0 x_{0} 表示 T T 去诺的回合后干净的序列. 根据LLADA风格的遮掩扩散配方[13],带有参数的denoiser预测符号分布p θ (⋅ ∣ ∣ ∣ ∣ ∣ ∣ ⋅ ⋅ ⋅). 每轮都作出最有信心的预测,并掩盖剩余位置,供进一步完善。

blocks.en: HyperQ preserves this iterative denoising process and modifies only the internal representation computed at each round. Each of the 22 22 transformer blocks contains a quantum residual branch that receives the hidden state h h of each token and emits that token’s circuit coordinates. For a register of n n qubits, the circuit skeleton is the edge set E E . The ring layer connects each qubit to its neighbour, and the chord layer connects each qubit to another qubit at a fixed stride. Every qubit therefore participates in exactly four couplings, and | E | = 2 ​ n |E|=2n . The branch controls the ring and chord layers independently by emitting separate coordinates for their edges.
blocks.zh: HyperQ 保留了这种迭代去诺过程,只修改每回合计算出来的内部代表. 在22个变压器区块中,每个变压器区块都有一个量子残基,接收每个代号的隐藏状态hh,并发出该代号的电路坐标. 对于n n qubits的寄存器,电路骨架是边缘设置的E E. 环层将每个qubit连接到它的邻居,和弦层将每个qubit连接到另一个qubit在一个固定的阶梯上. 因此,每个qubit都参与精确的4个组合,而QQ E = 2 n = QQ E =2n. 分支通过为边缘排放单独的坐标来独立控制环和弦层.

blocks.en: The emitted coordinates specify a strict instantaneous quantum polynomial-time (IQP) block. The branch emits single-qubit rotation angles α = { α q } \alpha=\{\alpha_{q}\} , two-qubit coupling angles ω E = { ω e : e ∈ E } \omega_{E}=\{\omega_{e}:e\in E\} and per-qubit readout axes ψ = { ψ q } \psi=\{\psi_{q}\} . Here, q q indexes a qubit and e e indexes an edge of E E . blocks.en: 2.2 Classical baseline comparison
blocks.zh: 2.2 经典基线比较

blocks.en: HyperQ attains the highest accuracy in every column of the six-benchmark suite, including comparisons with classical models up to eight times its size. At 64 qubits, HyperQ reaches a six-benchmark average of 54.30 54.30 . Qwen3-8B reaches 53.79 53.79 , LLaDA-8B reaches 53.37 53.37 and the frozen LLaDA-1.1B backbone underlying HyperQ reaches 49.59 49.59 (Table 1 ). HyperQ obtains this result using a tenth of the fine-tuning tokens used by the baselines. The reported downstream score averages ARC-e, HellaSwag, PIQA, BoolQ, RACE and GSM8K. These six tasks form the union of the benchmarks reported by the compared methods. Table 1 also reports WikiText perplexity, for which lower values are better, and the GLUE score. WikiText is the one column HyperQ does not lead. Qwen3-8B reaches 10.61 10.61 against 10.95 10.95 at 64 qubits, so the perplexity gap to the largest autoregressive baseline is not closed.
blocks.zh: HyperQ在6个基准套件的每一列中都达到最高的准确度,包括与古典模型的比较,最高可达其大小的8倍. 在64qubits, Hyper 时 Q达到六标平均54.30 54.30. Qune3-8B达到53.79 53.79,LLaDA-8B达到53.37 53.37,冰冻的LLaDA-1.1B主干基础HyperQ达到49.59 49.59(表1). HyperQ使用基线所用的十分之一的微调符号来获得这个结果. 报告的下游分数平均值为ARC-e,HelaSwag,PIQA,BoulQ,RACE和GSM8K. 这六项任务构成了比较方法报告的基准的结合。 表1还报告了WikiText的复杂程度,其中较低的数值较好,GLUE得分. WikiText 是一个列 HyperQ 不领导。 Qwen3-8B在64qubits时达到10.61 10.61对10.95 10.95,因此与最大自旋基线的复杂差距没有被关闭.

blocks.en: A classical low-rank branch explains only part of the improvement over the frozen backbone. The classically adapted models isolate the effect of adding adapter capacity without introducing an emitted circuit. The low-rank adapter on the same frozen backbone matches the classical component that HyperQ replaces, so the comparison controls for the corresponding adapter capacity. Adding the adapter raises TinyLlama from 48.73 48.73 to 49.98 49.98 and LLaDA from 49.59 49.59 to 50.63 50.63 . The adapter therefore contributes roughly a point and a quarter in both backbones. HyperQ at 64 qubits exceeds the adapted diffusion backbone by 3.67 3.67 points. This remaining gain separates the emitted circuit from the effect of merely adding parameters through a low-rank branch.
blocks.zh: 一个古典低级分支只解释了冰冻骨干的部分改进. 经典改造的模型隔离了增加适配器能力而不引入排放电路的效果. 同一冷冻骨干上的低级适配器与HyperQ所取代的经典组件相匹配,因此对应适配器容量的比较控制. 加上适配器,将TinyLlama从48.73 48.73提高到49.98 49.98,LLaDA从49.59 49.59提高到50.63 50.63. 因此,适配器在两个骨干中贡献了大约1分1/4. 64qubits的HyperQ超过了经调整的传播主干线3.67 3.67分. 剩余收益将排放的电路与仅仅通过低阶分支添加参数的效果区分开来.

blocks.en: Direct comparison with the results originally reported for earlier quantum-augmented models is not possible because those studies use different evaluation suites. HyQuT [ 21 ] reports generation quality on its own dialogue corpus. The Cayley adapters [ 23 ] report WikiText perplexity on frozen large models. The quantum-tensor hybrid adapter [ 25 ] reports supervised fine-tuning loss and generation scores on Chinese instruction data. Quantum-PEFT [ 24 ] reports GLUE, E2E and CIFAR-10 with a quantum-inspired parameterisation. None of these studies reports the standard zero-shot commonsense and reasoning suite, so their published results provide no shared benchmark for direct comparison with HyperQ.
blocks.zh: 无法与原先为早期量子增强模型报告的结果进行直接比较,因为这些研究使用了不同的评价套件。 HyQuT[21]报告其自己的对话体的生成质量. Cayley适配器[23]报告WikiText关于冷冻大模型的迷惑性. 量子-高压杂交适配器[25]监督微调中国指令数据损失和生成分数. 量子-PEFT[24]报告GLUE,E2E和CIFAR-10带有量子启发参数化. 这些研究都没有报告标准的零射常识和推理套件,因此其公布的结果没有为直接比较HyperQ提供共同的基准.

blocks.en: Model scale and architectural family are separated by grouping the rows of Table 1 by family. The two classical families appear at 1.1B and at their larger released sizes, whereas the quantum-enhanced models are grouped by their use of a quantum component. Within this comparison, HyperQ at 16 qubits reaches 47.65 47.65 and exceeds Llama-2-7B at 47.20 47.20 . HyperQ is also the first among these quantum-enhanced models to report the standard six-benchmark downstream suite, which enables direct comparison with size-matched classical diffusion and autoregressive baselines.
blocks.zh: 模范规模和建筑家庭通过将表1的行按家庭分类来划分. 两个古典家族在1.1B和较大的释放大小出现,而量子增强模型则通过使用量子元件进行分组. 在这个比较中,16qubit的HyperQ达到47.65 47.65,超过. 拉玛-2-7B在47.20 47.20. HyperQ也是这些量子增强模型中第一个报告标准六标下游套件的,这可以直接与大小匹配的古典传播和自递性基线进行比较.

blocks.en: 2.3 Per-token circuit emission
blocks.zh: 2.3 偶联电路排放

blocks.en: Continuous per-token circuit emission outperforms both hand-designed circuits and discrete motif search at every register width. Table 3 compares three ways to obtain a circuit for each token at 16, 32 and 64 qubits. The fixed route uses hand-designed ansätze. The searched route selects discrete motifs, where a motif denotes a generator class assigned to a circuit slot. The emitted route uses the hypernetwork to map each token representation directly to continuous circuit coordinates. Both automatic routes improve on the fixed families at every width.
blocks.zh: 连续的每根电路排放的性能在每一个寄存器宽度上都超过了手设计的电路和离散的摩提夫搜索. 表3比较了以16,32和64qubit为每个令牌获得一个电路的三种方式. 固定路线使用手工设计的ansätze. 搜索路径选择离散的摩提夫,其中摩提夫表示分配给电路槽的生成器类. 发射的路由使用超网络将每个符号表示直接映射到连续电路坐标. 两条自动路线在每一个宽度上都改善了固定家庭。

blocks.en: At 16 qubits, neither automatic route exceeds the size-matched frozen backbone at 49.59 49.59 . This deficit disappears as the register widens. More importantly, the margin between the emitted circuit and the best fixed ansatz grows from 1.78 1.78 at 16 qubits to 2.74 2.74 at 32 and 3.68 3.68 at 64. The margin widens because the hand-designed families stop improving after 32 qubits, whereas the emitted circuit continues to improve.
blocks.zh: 在16qubit时,两个自动路线都没有超过49.59 49.59的大小匹配的冷冻骨干. 这种赤字随着登记册的扩大而消失。 更重要的是,所排放的电路与最佳固定安萨兹之间的比值从16qubit的1.781.78增加到32的2.742.74和64的3.683.68。 由于人工设计的家庭在32个qubit之后不再改善,而排放的电路继续改善,因此差幅扩大了。

blocks.en: The three routes adapt different circuit properties. The 3-motif search selects one generator class for each slot and remains within the IQP family. The 6-motif search can select motifs outside that family, which makes it the stronger search baseline at every width. The emitted circuit instead retains the same generator structure for every token. Its diagonal interior contains R z R_{z} on each qubit and R z ​ z R_{zz} on each edge of E E . The surrounding Hadamard layers transform these operations into R x R_{x} and R x ​ x R_{xx} operations on the register. The hypernetwork adapts the values of these gates and the readout axis ψ \psi that follows the Hadamard-diagonal-Hadamard (HDH) block. The emitted circuit therefore remains within the IQP family while outperforming a search that can leave it. None of the three routes produces a Z Z -only circuit because the diagonal Z Z generators are enclosed by the Hadamard layers.
blocks.zh: 三条路线适应不同的电路属性. 3-motif搜索为每个槽选择一个发电机类,并保留在IQP家族内. 6-motif搜索可以在这个家族之外选择motifs,这使得它成为每个宽度的更强大的搜索基线. 所排放的电路为每个令牌保留相同的发电机结构。 它的对角内部包含每个qubit上的R z R_{z}和E E的每个边缘上的R z z R_{zz}. 周边的哈达马尔德层将这些操作转换为Rx R_{x}和Rx R_{xx}在寄存器上的操作. 超网络会适应这些门的值以及沿Hadamard-diagonal-Hadamard(HDH)块的读取轴\\\ psi。 因此,所排放的电路仍然在IQP家族内,而其搜索工作却超过了能够离开的搜索。 由于对角Z Z发电机被哈达马尔德层封闭,因此这三条线路中都没有一条产生Z Z - 唯一的电路.

blocks.en: The advantage of emission exceeds the variation among the fixed circuit families. The hand-designed families differ by about one point at each width. The closest fixed analogue to the emitted block is iqp-diag, which uses the same HDH structure of ( 2 ) but sets its angles by hand. The emitted circuit exceeds iqp-diag by 2.93 2.93 , 3.70 3.70 and 4.59 4.59 points across the three widths. Each margin is larger than the entire spread among the fixed families. Discrete search also improves over fixed designs. The 6-motif variant reaches 47.42 47.42 , 51.20 51.20 and 52.30 52.30 . Combining fixed circuits at test time does not close the remaining gap. At 32 qubits, the best three-circuit ensemble reaches 52.24 52.24 , whereas the hypernetwork reaches 52.80 52.80 in one pass (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 排放的好处超过了固定电路家族之间的变化。 手工设计的家庭在每个宽度上大约各有一个点。 离排放区块最近的固定模拟是iqp-diag,它使用相同的(2)的HDH结构,但用手设定角度。 所排放的电路超过iqp-diag2.932.93、3.703.70和4.594.59点,跨越三个宽度。 每个差幅都大于固定家庭的整个分布。  Discrete 搜索也比固定设计有所改进. 6-motif变体达到47.42 47.42 , 51.20 51.20 和 52.30 52.30. 在测试时间将固定电路组合起来并不能拉近剩余缺口. 在32qubits时,最好的三路合唱团达到52.24 52.24,而超网络达到52.80 52.80(表3)。

blocks.en: Continuous token dependence produces the strongest result at every width. The IQP hypernetwork makes α \alpha , ω \omega and ψ \psi continuous functions of the token. It scores 47.65 47.65 at 16 qubits, 52.80 52.80 at 32 qubits and 54.30 54.30 at 64 qubits. At 64 qubits, this result exceeds the best fixed ansatz by 3.68 3.68 points, with 54.30 54.30 against 50.62 50.62 . Emission also outperforms the 3-motif IQP search by 1.95 1.95 points at 32 qubits and 2.35 2.35 points at 64 qubits. The gain therefore comes from replacing discrete motif selection with continuous token-conditioned axes and weights, rather than from departing from the commuting-generator structure.
blocks.zh: 持续的符号依赖在每个宽度产生最强的结果. IQP 超网络使 α\ alpha 、\\ omega 和\ psi 连续的函数值 。 它在16qubit的成绩为47.65 47.65分,在32qubit的成绩为52.80 52.80分,在64qubit的成绩为54.30 54.30分. 在64qubits上,这个结果超过最佳固定安萨的3.683.68分,54.30 54.30比50.62 50.62. 排放量也超过了3-motif IQP的搜索,在32qubit上达到1.951.95分,在64qubit上达到2.352.35分. 因此,收益来自用连续的象征性条件轴和权重来取代离散的动因选择,而不是偏离通勤-生成结构.

blocks.en: Search only partly commits, whereas emission produces token-dependent couplings and readouts and attains the highest downstream score. From a uniform 1 / 3 1/3 start, the 3-motif IQP search learns a motif-selection probability per generator class in each of L = 4 L=4 slots (Fig. 3 a). Three slots favour one class with probabilities 0.69, 0.66 and 0.54, while the fourth remains mixed at 0.42, leaving substantial probability mass outside each preferred class. At 16 qubits, coupling angles across 4,096 tokens and the 32 edges of E E have per-edge medians of 0.12 to 0.35 radians, below the fixed ansatz value of 0.5 (Fig. 3 b). blocks.en: Continuous emission allows each token to determine which gates remain active within the edge set E E . Every emitted coordinate can approach zero, and setting a coordinate to zero removes the corresponding gate from the closed-form readout. An inert coupling coordinate ω e \omega_{e} removes the coupling on edge e e , whereas an inert rotation coordinate α q \alpha_{q} removes the rotation on qubit q q . The circuit support therefore adapts together with the nonzero parameters rather than being fixed in advance. In particular, the 2 2 ​ n 2^{2n} subgraphs of E E occur as coordinate hyperplanes within a single continuous chart. Fig. 4 recovers this support selection from the emitted angles by treating a coordinate as active when its magnitude exceeds 0.10 0.10 radians. Only 6.4 6.4 per cent of tokens retain every edge of E E at 16 qubits, and this fraction falls to 0.1 0.1 per cent at 64. On average, each qubit retains 2.58 2.58 of its four available couplings. The branch therefore uses the fixed edge set E E as a common skeleton while selecting a different active subgraph for each token.

blocks.en: Most emitted circuits retain entangling gates, but their active supports differ substantially across tokens. We summarise these supports with five motif classes: Ring and chord, Ring, Chord, Product and Identity. This grouping follows the connectivity patterns commonly used to catalogue fixed ansätze. Ring, line and all-to-all arrangements have measurably different expressibility and entangling capability at equal depth [ 46 ] . The Ring and chord class in Fig. 4 contains the 55.8 55.8 per cent of tokens that retain active couplings in both layers. Another 23.2 23.2 per cent belong to the Ring class, which retains only the ring layer and reduces to the nearest-neighbour arrangement used by the hand-designed families. The Chord class contains the 6.3 6.3 per cent that retain only the long-range chord layer. The Product class contains the 8.0 8.0 per cent that retain no coupling but preserve a product of single-qubit rotations. The remaining 6.7 6.7 per cent belong to the Identity class, in which both rotations and couplings are inert. For the Identity class, the readout on qubit q q collapses to ψ q , z \psi_{q,z} , the z z component of its emitted readout axis.
blocks.zh: 大多数被发射的电路保留了缠绕门,但其主动支持在符号上差别很大. 我们将这些支持归纳为五个主要类别: 环和弦,环,弦,产品和身份. 这种分组遵循了通常用于编目固定的ansätze的连接模式. 环线、线线和所有安排在同等深度上具有显著不同的表达和缠绕能力[46]。 Fig. 4中的环形和弦类包含55.8 55.8%的代币在两层中保留了主动耦合. 另有23.2 23.2%属于环形类,该类仅保留环形层,并缩小至手设计家族使用的近邻安排. 和弦类包含6.3%,只保留长程和弦层. 产品类包含8.0 8.0%,不保留耦合,但保留单方位旋转的产物. 其余6.7%属于身份等级,其中轮替和耦合都是惰性. 对于身份类,在 qubit q q 上读出为\ q, z\ psi\\q, z}, 其释放读出轴的 z z 组件 。

blocks.en: The five motif classes provide only a coarse summary of the emitted diversity. The rank-frequency distribution over exact supports has a long tail because the token stream that controls the branch is itself steeply unequal. A flat assignment would instead indicate that the circuit support had stopped tracking the token. At 16 qubits, 9,130 9{,}130 of 20,000 20{,}000 tokens carry a support that no other token shares. At 64 qubits, that count rises to 17,778 17{,}778 .
blocks.zh: 五个分类只粗略总结了所排放的多样性。 相对于精确支持的级别频率分布有很长的尾巴,因为控制分支的符号流本身是尖锐的不平等的. 相反,一项统一的任务表明,电路支持已停止跟踪信号。 在16qubits,9,130 9{,}20,000 20{,}000个信使中,有1个支持没有其他信使股份. 在64qubits,这个计数上升到17,778 17{,}778.

blocks.en: The branch allocates denser entangling supports to token categories that carry more lexical information. The mean number of active couplings per qubit increases from 0.99 0.99 for punctuation to 1.88 1.88 for function words, 3.08 3.08 for numerals, 3.44 3.44 for content words and 3.73 3.73 for rare subwords. Across the same categories, the share of tokens in the Ring and chord class rises from 7.8 7.8 to 97.0 97.0 per cent. Identity is concentrated on punctuation. The branch selects Identity for 30.2 30.2 per cent of punctuation tokens and for almost no numerals, content words or rare subwords. The branch therefore allocates entanglement according to token category and switches off its circuit interior most often for punctuation. Neither a fixed ansatz nor a per-task search is designed to express this token-level policy.

blocks.en: 2.5 Circuit synthesis and compilation
blocks.zh: 2.5 电路合成和汇编

blocks.en: The token-dependent support would be impractical inside a billion-parameter model if each circuit required a full statevector or an unconstrained compilation procedure. HyperQ instead lowers every emitted circuit into an executable gate sequence under fixed gate-count and depth budgets. This compilation produces one representation per token for both model evaluation and hardware transpilation, where transpilation maps the circuit to the native gates and coupling map of the target processor.
blocks.zh: 如果每条电路都需要一个完全的状态器或一个不受约束的编译程序,那么在十亿参数模型内依赖符号的支持是不切实际的。 HyperQ转而将每个排放的电路降低到固定闸门计数和深度预算下可执行闸门序列中. 这份汇编为模型评价和硬件转录制作一个每个符号的表示,其中转录图将电路映射到原生闸门,并绘制目标处理器的耦合图.

blocks.en: The compiled circuit realises the strict-IQP block of ( 2 ). Because this block contains only two-body generators, its ⟨ Z q ⟩ \langle Z_{q}\rangle expectation values can be evaluated in Θ ⁡ ( n ) \Theta(n) time, linear in the register width n n , without constructing the full 2 n 2^{n} statevector. This closed-form readout keeps circuits of 16, 32 and 64 qubits usable within a 1.1B-parameter model. The same budgeted circuits transpile to the native gates and coupling map of the target superconducting hardware. The ablation in Table 3 and the on-device runs therefore use the same per-token compilation pipeline. The synthesis and transpilation passes are specified in the Methods.

blocks.en: 2.6 Quantum register scaling
blocks.zh: 2.6 量子登记册缩放

blocks.en: The emitted circuit continues to improve as the register widens, whereas the best fixed circuits begin to saturate after 32 qubits. We denote the six-benchmark average by A A . The emitted circuit and both searched variants improve from 16 to 64 qubits (Table 3 , Fig. 5 ). The hypernetwork remains below the 49.59 49.59 frozen backbone at 16 qubits, overtakes it at 32 and reaches a score 4.7 4.7 points higher at 64. The three circuit-construction routes separate further as the register widens. Between 32 and 64 qubits, the best fixed ansatz gains 0.56 0.56 points and the searched circuits gain 1.10 1.10 , whereas the emitted circuit gains 1.50 1.50 . Widening a hand-designed circuit therefore yields diminishing returns over this range, while the emitted circuit continues to benefit from the additional width.
blocks.zh: 随着寄存器的扩大,排放的电路继续改善,而最好的固定电路则在32qubit后开始饱和。 我们以A表示6个基准平均值。 所排放的电路和搜索的两种变体从16qubit改进为64qubit(表3,图5)。 超网络仍位于16qubit的49.5949.59冷冻骨干以下,32时超过,64时达到4.74.7分高分. 随着登记册的扩大,三条线路建设路线进一步分离。 在32至64个qubit之间,最好的固定安萨得到0.56 0.56分,被搜索的线路得到1.10 1.10分,而排放的线路得到1.50 1.50分。 因此,扩大人工设计的电路可减少这一范围内的回报率,而所排放的电路继续受益于增加的宽度。

blocks.en: The gradient scale at initialisation remains constant across the width sweep. The variance of the gradient with respect to an emitted circuit coordinate depends on the number of couplings incident to its qubit, rather than on the total number of qubits. The edge set E E fixes this degree at four across all three widths because it contains one ring layer and one chord layer. Consequently, widening the register does not introduce a width-dependent vanishing gradient at initialisation (Methods).
blocks.zh: 初始化时的梯度尺度在宽度扫描时保持不变。 所排放的电路坐标的梯度差异取决于其方位的耦合事件的数目,而不是方位的总数。 边缘设置 E 将这个度修正为四个,跨越所有三个宽度,因为它包含一个环层和一个和弦层. 因此,扩大登记册不会在初始化(方法)时引入宽度递减梯度。

blocks.en: Independent simulation paths verify the analytic readout before device execution. Every simulation score uses the exact analytic closed form of ( 5 ), which is also the readout used during training. At 16 qubits, where both alternative simulation paths remain affordable, a dense statevector agrees with the analytic value to a mean absolute deviation of 1.1 × 10 − 5 1.1\times 10^{-5} , while an exact tensor-network contraction agrees to 3.2 × 10 − 7 3.2\times 10^{-7} . The larger statevector deviation is consistent with its use of complex64 , compared with float64 for the tensor network. This cross-check verifies the closed-form implementation without requiring a dense 2 n 2^{n} statevector at 32 or 64 qubits.

blocks.en: The downstream degradation remains bounded but varies by benchmark. Fig. 6 compares simulation and device scores for each benchmark on the same 256-item subset. Because the model weights and evaluation items are fixed within every pair, each reported difference isolates the effect of replacing the analytic readout with the device measurement. The average score decreases by 0.34 0.34 , 0.68 0.68 and 1.12 1.12 points at 16, 32 and 64 qubits, respectively. GSM8K incurs the largest loss at every width, reaching 1.79 1.79 points at 64 qubits, whereas PIQA incurs the smallest loss, at 0.74 0.74 points. The benchmark pattern therefore tracks how much of the answer the model must produce rather than select, with generated reasoning outputs more sensitive to accumulated readout error than short-choice decisions.
blocks.zh: 下游的退化仍然有限度,但因基准而异。 图6比较了每个基准在相同的256项子集上的模拟和装置分数. 由于模型权重和评价项目固定在每个对内,因此每个报告的差异都隔离了用设备测量取代分析读取的效果. 平均得分分别减少0.34 0.34,0.68 0.68和1.12 1.12分,分别以16分,32分和64qubit. GSM8K每宽损失最大,在64qubits时达到1.791.79分,而PIQA损失最小,为0.740.74分. 因此,基准模式跟踪模型必须产生多少答案而不是选择多少答案,生成的推理产出比短选决定更敏感地注意累积读出错误。

blocks.en: The hardware evaluation is intentionally bounded. Each benchmark contributes the same number of items so that its score has equal weight in the average, but the number of emitted circuits depends on token count and therefore varies with item length. The coverage panels report both quantities against the full released split of each benchmark. These paired inference-time measurements establish that the emitted circuits can be executed on superconducting hardware while preserving most of their downstream performance. They do not evaluate native hardware-based training or establish quantum advantage.
blocks.zh: 硬件评价是故意的。 每个基准都提供相同数量的项目,因此其得分在平均值中具有同等的权重,但所排放的电路数量取决于符号计数,因此因项目长度而异. 覆盖小组对照每个基准全部释放的分数报告这两个数量。 这些配对的推论时间测量确定,所排放的电路可以在超导硬件上执行,同时保留其大部分下游性能. 它们不评价以硬件为基础的本土培训或确立量子优势。

blocks.en: HyperQ preserves the parallel, any-order decoding capabilities of its masked-diffusion backbone while improving downstream accuracy. Bidirectional attention allows a masked-diffusion model to fill positions in different orders and to commit several positions in one forward pass. An autoregressive model cannot provide either capability because it must decode sequentially from left to right. We evaluate three decoding orders and vary the number of tokens committed in each forward pass. The operating point denotes the commitment setting used for the reported benchmark evaluations.

blocks.en: HyperQ maintains generation quality across all tested decoding orders. Confidence-ordered unmasking, which commits the highest-confidence predictions first, performs best (Fig. 7 a). The autoregressive baseline is defined only for left-to-right decoding, so the other two settings have no autoregressive counterpart. The difference becomes larger on tasks that explicitly depend on decoding order. The autoregressive model degrades sharply when questions are reversed and when text must be infilled. Both diffusion models retain their performance, and HyperQ remains strongest throughout (Fig. 7 b).
blocks.zh: HyperQ在所有测试的解码命令中保持生成质量. 最先作出最高信任预测的自信解密表现最好(图7a)。 自动递归基线仅为左对右解码而定义,因此其他两种设置没有自动递归对应. 对于明确取决于解码秩序的任务,这种差异会变得更大. 自动递减模型在问题倒置和文本必须填充时会急剧退化. 两种传播模式都保持其性能,HyperQ在整个过程中保持最强(图7b).

blocks.en: HyperQ also preserves the throughput trade-off provided by parallel token commitment. Committing more tokens in each forward pass reduces accuracy, as is typical for parallel decoding, but HyperQ degrades more slowly than its backbone (Fig. 7 c). Masked diffusion converts this parallel commitment into higher decoding throughput at scale [ 16 ] . At the benchmark level, the improvement over the backbone is concentrated on RACE and HellaSwag and remains close to neutral on ARC-e and GSM8K (Fig. 7 d).
blocks.zh: 超时 Q还保留了平行象征性承诺提供的吞吐量权衡。 在每个前传中交接更多的令牌会降低精度,这是平行解码的典型做法,但HyperQ的降解速度比它的骨干慢(图7 c). 蒙面扩散将这种平行承诺转化为规模上更高的解码吞吐量[16]. 在基准一级,主干部分的改进主要集中在RACE和HelaSwag,在ARC-e和GSM8K(图7d)方面仍然接近中立。

blocks.en: 3 Discussion
blocks.zh: 3 讨论情况

blocks.en: HyperQ outperforms the tested fixed and searched circuits at every evaluated width, and both margins widen across the three tested widths. At 64 qubits, the emitted circuit is 3.68 3.68 points above the best tested hand-designed ansatz and 2.35 2.35 points above the tested 3-motif IQP search. The fixed ansatz families show little additional improvement after 32 qubits, whereas the emitted circuit continues to improve through 64 qubits. Within the measured range, this widening gap supports the architectural claim that additional circuit width is more useful when the coordinates adapt to each token than when every token reuses a fixed ansatz or selects among discrete motifs. These results do not establish a scaling law beyond the three tested widths.
blocks.zh: HyperQ在每一个经评估的宽度上都超过了经过测试的固定和搜索的电路,两个边距都拓宽了经过测试的三个宽度. 在64qubits上,所排放的电路比经过测试的手设计安萨兹高3.683.68分,比经过测试的3-motif IQP搜索高2.352.35分. 固定的Ansatz家庭在32个qubit后几乎没有任何额外的改进,而排放的电路通过64个qubit继续改善。 在测量范围内,这一不断扩大的缺口支持了建筑学上的主张,即当坐标适应每个令牌时,额外的电路宽度比每个令牌重用一个固定的安萨兹或者在离散的马提夫中选择更有用. 这些结果并没有确立一个超过三个测试宽度的缩放定律.

blocks.en: The comparison remains computationally feasible because HyperQ fixes the interaction degree as the register widens. The edge set E E consists of a ring layer and one chord layer, so every qubit has degree four. This bounded degree provides two distinct properties. The complete expectation-value readout has exact cost Θ ⁡ ( n ) \Theta(n) and therefore avoids constructing a 2 n 2^{n} statevector. Under the specified independent reference initialisation, the variance of a derivative with respect to an emitted circuit coordinate is 1 / 48 1/48 independently of n n . Degree four thus prevents the reference variance from shrinking as register width increases. This result characterises the emitted circuit at initialisation, rather than the frozen backbone or the complete optimisation trajectory, and therefore does not guarantee trainability in general.
blocks.zh: 比较在计算上仍然可行,因为HyperQ会随着寄存器的扩展而修正交互度. 边缘设定E E由环状层和一个和弦层组成,因此每个qubit都有四级. 这一受限学位提供了两种不同的属性. 完整的期望值读出有 \\ (n)\(n)\(n) 的精确成本, 从而避免构建 2 n 2\(n)} 状态器 。 在指定的独立参考初始化下,一个衍生物相对于一个被排放的电路坐标的差异是1/48/1/48,独立于n n. 因此,第4级防止参考差异因收件宽度增加而缩小。 这种结果在初始化时对所排放的电路进行定性,而不是冷冻的骨干或完全优化的轨迹,因此不能保证一般的可训练性。

blocks.en: The same two-body structure that makes HyperQ affordable also makes its readout classically simulable. It yields an exact closed form for each ⟨ Z q ⟩ \langle Z_{q}\rangle , and the readout factorises over the edges incident to each qubit. HyperQ therefore tests whether token-conditioned circuit emission provides a useful architectural bias, rather than whether quantum hardware performs a classically intractable computation. This trade-off is consistent with theory [ 29 ] connecting non-vanishing gradients to efficient classical simulation in relevant circuit families. We claim no quantum computational advantage.
blocks.zh: 同样的双体结构使得HyperQ能够负担得起,也使得它的读取古典般的模拟. 它为每个 Z q q \ langle Z q rangle 生成一个精确的闭合形式,读出因子在边缘上对每个方位事件进行分解. 超时 因此,Q测试象征性的有条件的电路排放是否提供有用的建筑偏差,而不是量子硬件是否进行古典棘手的计算. 这种权衡与理论[29]一致,将相关电路家族中不折不扣的梯度与高效的古典模拟联系起来. 我们声称没有量子计算优势。

blocks.en: A computational result would require both a circuit family whose relevant outputs are not efficiently classically simulable and a task on which quantum execution supplies a meaningful separation. One target is a distribution [ 47 ] that constant-depth quantum circuits can sample but constant-round diffusion language models provably cannot. Success on a task drawn from such a distribution could convert the present architectural result into a computational one. Reaching that target would require leaving the commuting circuit family whose exact readout makes the current width study feasible. It would also require evaluating the claimed separation directly, rather than inferring it from downstream language benchmarks or hardware execution alone.
blocks.zh: 计算结果既需要其相关产出在传统意义上无法有效实现的电路家族,也需要量子执行提供有意义的分离的任务。 一个目标是分布[47],恒深量子电路可以采样,但恒圆扩散语言模型可以证明不能. 成功完成从这种分布中得出的任务可以将目前的建筑结果转化为计算结果。 要达到这个目标,就必须离开通勤电路家族,因为其准确的读取使得目前的宽度研究是可行的。 这还需要直接评估所称的分离,而不是从下游语言基准或硬件执行中推断出来。

At inference, the model starts from a fully masked sequence and applies the
denoiser for T T refinement rounds. Each round predicts the masked tokens in
parallel, commits a schedule-determined subset of those predictions and
re-masks the remaining positions. The process ends when it has recovered x 0 x_{0} . In our configuration, each example is truncated to a block of L ≤ 1024 L\leq 1024 tokens, and inference runs for T = 128 T=128 reverse rounds. Between
rounds, we commit the highest-confidence predictions and re-mask the remainder
following the LLaDA procedure [ 13 ] . Because each round can use
context on both sides of a masked position, this procedure preserves
bidirectional decoding instead of imposing a left-to-right order.

straight-through estimator. The forward pass uses the motif with the largest

supply gradients. We condition the architecture logits on the token
representation and initialise them at a small scale. Training therefore begins
near a uniform mixture and specialises the slots only when the masked-diffusion
loss favours a particular generator class.

The closed form must also execute inside every training step without a
per-token Python loop. The map from one token’s angles and coupling weights to

on the first call of a run rather than at every transformer block of every
training step. The vmap transformation promotes the token axis into
the tensor operations, so a minibatch of distinct circuits can be evaluated
together. We process each minibatch in fixed-size token chunks and pad the
final chunk. This procedure bounds the peak branch activation memory on each
device and keeps the traced tensor shape constant across steps.

sampled 20,000 20{,}000 -pair subset, which contains one tenth of the tokens used for

We evaluate downstream quality zero-shot with the eval_mdm pipeline,
an lm-eval-style harness adapted to masked-diffusion readout. For each
multiple-choice item, the pipeline scores every candidate completion by its
conditional log-likelihood under the diffusion bound. It estimates this
quantity with up to 128 Monte Carlo mask samples per item and uses an
evaluation batch size of 8.

To measure simulator-to-hardware transfer, we additionally execute the emitted
per-token circuits on the 156 156 -qubit IBM superconducting processors ibm_quebec and ibm_brisbane . Execution uses Qiskit Runtime
EstimatorV2 at 10 000 10\,000 shots. This shot count targets a precision of 10 − 2 10^{-2} for every expectation value consumed by the backbone. The hardware
pass is a bounded validation on a task subset rather than a full benchmark
sweep, as the coverage figure makes explicit. Within each benchmark, we draw

despite their different split sizes. We emit and execute one circuit per token,

the change caused by executing the emitted circuits on noisy devices.
